title: Analyzing Uncertainty of LLM-as-a-Judge: Interval Evaluations with Conformal Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Mean Squared Error (MSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and correlation metrics between LLM-generated scores (raw scores, weighted averages, and interval midpoints) and human ground-truth ratings to evaluate which method provides a less biased estimate of human preference.

Qualitatively observing the impact of changing the order of information in the prompt (e.g., moving interval information to the front) to mitigate position bias during the LLM judge's reprompting and regrading process.
